summary: Klamath NF site in Siskiyou County, CA: tower under construction as a planned 50-ft structure in July 1928; FFLA lists it as a platform, now gone; FFLOS-registered 2026.

facts.design: Planned in July 1928 as a 50-foot tower with a 12-foot base and an 8-foot platform on top; FFLA now lists the site as a platform
facts.status_note: FFLA California list marks the site Gone; no removal date or completion date appears in the sources read

events.note: Under construction as of July 1928; the entry gives the planned height and bracing, and no completion date appears in the sources read
Frank Joseph to man the tower in emergencies, per the July 1928 entry
Registered January 1, 2026; nominated by Darin McQuoid; US 2114, CA 171

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the 1928 entry is the only dated detail; no completion date, staffing record or removal date was found. FFLA California list row confirms Platform and Gone (Siskiyou row, not the Santa Cruz or Trinity Eagle Rock rows). The Forest Lookouts page only repeats the 1928 quote. The FFLOS page has a June 2025 photo but no image URL in the cached text, so none added to photos. Public access is not stated anywhere; facts.access omitted. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads for this tower.
